page.overview:
Who is Astral Knight?

Astral Knight is an Autobot who appears in the game Transformers: Online. A veteran, he has participated in multiple battles throughout the Great War. Through this long and storied experience, he has become all too familiar with the destruction and cruelty Megatron and his Decepticons bring. Despite his best efforts, Astral Knight was unable to prevent the fall of Cybertron. He now fights to prevent the same fate from befalling Earth and humanity. Category:Transformers Online Autobots Category:Males
